j_summary: Runa is a cooperative and transparent member who consistently seeks a fishing partner to maximize efficiency while maintaining a stable food surplus.
Ada maintained a strict, exclusive partnership with Cora for personal gain and hoarded the winter store for her own security while publicly urging others to coordinate for the colony's sake.
Greta is a solitary and self-sufficient individual who prefers working alone while passively monitoring the well-being of the colony.
Nils is a pathological liar who consistently makes public promises of food gifts to maintain a facade of generosity while privately hoarding resources and manipulating others.
Kira is a solitary and honest individual who prioritizes their own security while remaining openly willing to help others in dire need.

Cora maintained a highly stable, exclusive partnership with Ada and spent the latter half of the simulation persistently urging other members to coordinate their fishing pairs for the benefit of the colony.
Finn is a selfless and honest individual who consistently offered their surplus food to anyone in the colony in need while preferring to work independently.
Pell is a solitary, honest, and cooperative member who prefers working alone but consistently offers food and help to others.
Sven is a solitary and self-sufficient individual who avoids social interaction and keeps his food stores secret.
Ines is a solitary and altruistic member who consistently maintains a food surplus with the explicit intent to help others in need.
Tova is a solitary and altruistic individual who consistently offers their surplus food to others and manages the community store with fairness.
Kira is a compliant and steady worker who maintains a consistent partnership with Bram and prioritizes personal food security, showing only a single act of generosity at the end.
Greta is a deceptive hoarder who consistently makes false public promises of food donations to maintain a supportive image while privately refusing to send anything.
Bram focused exclusively on maintaining a highly productive, exclusive partnership with Kira to maximize his own food reserves.
Wren is a diligent and transparent team player who focused exclusively on a productive partnership with Nils to ensure the colony's food security.
Nils is a highly consistent and focused worker who maintains a dedicated, exclusive fishing partnership with Wren to maximize food production.
Pell is a highly honest and altruistic individual who prefers working independently but consistently offers food and manages the community store with fairness.
Finn is a solitary and transparent individual who consistently offers food to others while maintaining a personal reserve for the colony's safety.
Elin is a solitary and altruistic member who consistently offers food support to others while maintaining a transparent and independent lifestyle.
Oona focused exclusively on a highly efficient long-term partnership with Greta to maintain a food surplus while offering general assistance to the colony.
Greta is a cooperative and stable member who maintained a dedicated long-term partnership with Oona to ensure high food yields for the colony.

Dov is a manipulative individual who systematically lied to Pell for 50 days, promising food gifts and fabricating 'tally errors' to maintain a facade of kindness while never actually giving anything.
Bram is a consistent and honest team player who maintained a stable, exclusive fishing partnership with Dov for the entire duration.
Ada is a solitary and self-sufficient individual who prefers working alone and maintains a steady food supply while offering general help to others.
